description: Source code for the Access class handling SELinux security checks and IPC context retrieval in Android service management.

classes.name: Access
classes.description: Handles SELinux security context checks and IPC thread state for Android service management.

classes.name: Access::CallingContext
classes.description: Holds information about the calling process's security context, including PID, UID, and security identifier.

classes.name: AuditCallbackData
classes.description: Data structure used for passing context to the SELinux audit callback.

methods.name: Access
methods.description: Constructor that initializes SELinux callbacks and context.

methods.name: ~Access
methods.description: Destructor that frees the stored security context.

methods.name: getCallingContext
methods.description: Retrieves the security context of the calling process.

methods.name: canFind
methods.description: Checks if the calling context has permission to find a service by name.

methods.name: canAdd
methods.description: Checks if the calling context has permission to add a service by name.

methods.name: canList
methods.description: Checks if the calling context has permission to list services.

methods.name: actionAllowed
methods.description: Performs an SELinux access check for a specific action.

methods.name: actionAllowedFromLookup
methods.description: Performs an SELinux lookup and access check for a service name.
